MAINTENANCE.description: Action related to maintenance on the piece of equipment.

PRODUCTION.description: A structural element is currently producing product.

PROCESS_DEVELOPMENT.description: A structural element is being used to prove-out a new process.

SETUP.description: A structural element is being prepared or modified to begin production           of product.

TEARDOWN.description: Typically, a structural element has completed the production of a           product and is being modified or returned to a neutral state such that           it may then be prepared to begin production of a different product.
